description: Basic requirement extraction — single solicitation with clear mandatory items.

SOURCE_CHUNKS.text: CLIN 0001: NSN 6505-01-345-6789, Qty 500 BX. Unit price: ___. MANDATORY: Delivery within 30 days ARO.
MANDATORY: Proposals shall not exceed 5 pages. Due by October 30, 2026.

Award will be made to lowest price technically acceptable offeror.

notes: Three mandatory requirements should be found: delivery, page limit, SAM registration. Award criteria (LPTA) is informational.
